# Ozarks Concrete Coatings

> Ozarks Concrete Coatings is a local, owner-operated epoxy and polyaspartic floor coating contractor based in Springfield, Missouri, serving a 75-mile radius across Southwest Missouri (50+ cities and communities). Every install uses full diamond-grinding prep and an epoxy-polyaspartic/polyurea hybrid basecoat system, backed by a written Lifetime Warranty against fading, peeling, and yellowing. Most jobs are completed in a single day.

Key facts: phone 417.402.6821, email OzarksConcreteCoatings@gmail.com, based in Springfield/Nixa MO, 5.0 rating across 152 Google reviews, no travel charge within the standard service radius.

## Services

- [Epoxy Garage Floors](https://ozarksgaragequote.com/garage-floors.html): Full-flake, solid color, and metallic garage floor coatings.
- [Basement Floors](https://ozarksgaragequote.com/basement-floors.html): Moisture-resistant basement and finished-lower-level coatings.
- [Metallic Epoxy](https://ozarksgaragequote.com/metallic-epoxy.html): Custom metallic pour floors for showrooms, garages, and basements.
- [ManCaves & Shops](https://ozarksgaragequote.com/mancave-shop.html): Shop buildings, man caves, and home gym floor coatings.
- [Patio & Outdoor Coatings](https://ozarksgaragequote.com/patio-coatings.html): UV-stable outdoor coatings for patios, pool decks, and porches.
- [Churches & Schools](https://ozarksgaragequote.com/churches-schools.html): Institutional flooring for gymnasiums, fellowship halls, and classrooms.
- [Concrete Repair](https://ozarksgaragequote.com/concrete-repair.html): Crack repair, diamond grinding, and surface prep services.
